limits: Static source review and live dependency advisory lookup only. No tests, builds (other than Maven dependency resolution), application execution, load tests or exploitation.
No container OS/image, JDK/JVM/native library, browser internals or Oracle server vulnerability scan; container image tags are not immutable inventories.
No secrets were copied into results; production runtime secrets, secret rotation, git history and deployed file/network permissions were not inspected.
The six requested skill schemas cover exactly 59 CWE rules, not every CWE. NOT_FOUND means no verified matching pattern in the reviewed scope, not proof of absence.
advisorySource: Unauthenticated GitHub REST advisories API via curl (gh had no authentication)
assessmentScope: Full current repository application source/configuration, not a diff review. .github setup/generated artifacts, target, git history and binary image contents excluded.
dependencyScanCoverage: 104 resolved direct/transitive Maven coordinates including compile, runtime, optional development and test scopes; four GitHub REST batches of at most 30 with pagination. Also checked CDN Bootstrap 5.3.0. No failed REST batches.
cveInterpretation: 85 distinct non-withdrawn advisories match installed package versions. Dependency presence is verified; feature prerequisites, exploitability and deployment exposure are not established. Test/development dependencies are not equivalent to production attack surface.

nonChecklistObservations.topic: CSRF and Basic authentication configuration (outside requested 59-rule set)
nonChecklistObservations.observation: CSRF is explicitly disabled while browser-capable HTTP Basic authentication is enabled for state-changing POST routes; statelessness alone does not establish browser CSRF safety. This configuration warrants a separate CWE-352 review; no cross-origin runtime exploit was performed.

Provided compose publishes application HTTP port 8080, uses Basic authentication, and declares no TLS terminator or HTTPS requirement. External TLS termination/deployed network exposure were not verified.
